summary: Pull-request runs of the typescript-client and fractal-web-execution jobs check out the history the signing guard needs, so their shadow notes are signed instead of silently skipped

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change; CI configuration only.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. Nothing reads these notes to skip a check.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change. Required checks keep their names and outcomes; only the checkout depth of two jobs changes, on pull requests.

recovery.detail: Revert this change; notes already published stay valid and are only accepted through the base-commit key list.
